Read-only verification task. Do NOT edit anything. Fetch Confluence page ID 346783750 (title "Contentful Integration Technical Design & Content Model (SFCC-249)") using the mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_page tool (convert_to_markdown: true, include_metadata: true). If the tool result is too large and gets saved to a file instead of returned inline, read that file with jq/python/grep as instructed in the error message — do not give up.

Once you have the page content, verify these THREE specific edits were correctly applied. For each, report VERIFIED (quote the exact current text you found), NOT APPLIED (quote what's still there instead), or PARTIALLY APPLIED (quote what's there and explain the discrepancy).

EDIT 1 — Section "3. Options Analysis", subsection "3.1 Options Summary", the table row for "Option A" (SFCC ID as a non-localized ShortText field, resolved by MRT SSR-side filtering). Look at the "Cons" column for that row. BEFORE the edit, it had 3 bullet points, the first being "Authors enter a raw ID with no referential-integrity check against the live catalogue (typo risk)." EXPECTED AFTER THE EDIT: that specific bullet should be GONE, leaving only two cons: one about SSR cache keys needing to include the SFCC ID, and one about filtering logic being centralised in the MRT SSR layer. Quote the current Cons column content for Option A exactly.

EDIT 2 — Section "4. Recommended Option & Rationale", subsection "4.3 Trade-offs Accepted". BEFORE the edit, bullet 1 read: "Authors enter SFCC IDs by hand with no referential-integrity guardrail (typo risk). The installed Salesforce Commerce Cloud Connector app may improve the authoring step; the field mechanic is confirmed by SFCC-238." EXPECTED AFTER THE EDIT: that entire bullet should be GONE (deleted, not reworded), leaving only two remaining bullets (about SSR cache-key requirement, and about the design being proposed/not yet implemented). Quote the current full contents of the "4.3 Trade-offs Accepted" bullet list exactly.

EDIT 3 — Section "2. Constraints & Assumptions", subsection "2.2 Assumptions", the table row about the Contentful "Salesforce Commerce Cloud Connector app". BEFORE the edit it read (Assumption column): "The Contentful 'Salesforce Commerce Cloud Connector app' is installed and lets authors associate SFCC product/category references." (Risk if Wrong column): "If the connector app's field type and payload shape differ from the assumed ShortText model, the content-model field definitions need revision (owned by SFCC-238)." EXPECTED AFTER THE EDIT: the Assumption column should now ALSO state that the connector validates against the live catalogue at authoring time and immediately shows the author when an entered ID has no match (attributed to Tim Lavelle), while the Risk if Wrong column stays about the field type/payload shape being confirmed by SFCC-238. Quote the current full Assumption and Risk-if-Wrong text for that specific row exactly.

Also report: the current page VERSION NUMBER (should be 32 or higher, since it was v31 before these edits), and the current page's "Version History" table (section near the top) — does it have a new row describing these edits, or is it unchanged from before?

Return your findings as a clear numbered list (Edit 1 / Edit 2 / Edit 3 / Version info), each with an explicit verdict and an exact quote of the current live text. Be precise — do not paraphrase the quotes.
